title: Afternoon naps
subtitle: 「午睡／下午小睡」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？
description: 「午睡／下午小睡」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？

words.note: 和 afternoon naps 很接近，但範圍稍廣，可以是上午或下午的小睡。
words.example: Short daytime naps can help some people feel more alert.
words.exampleZh: 短暫的日間小睡可以幫助一些人恢復精神。

exercises.original: Some people find afternoon naps helpful when they are tired during the day.
exercises.zh: 有些人在白天感到疲倦時，覺得日間小睡很有幫助。
exercises.upgrade: Some people find daytime naps helpful when they are tired during the day.

options.explanation: 和 afternoon naps 很接近，只是時間範圍稍廣。

exercises.original: The study examined whether afternoon naps improve alertness.
exercises.zh: 研究探討日間小睡是否能提高警覺性。
exercises.upgrade: The study examined whether daytime naps improve alertness.

exercises.original: Older adults may benefit from short afternoon naps.
exercises.zh: 長者可能會從短暫日間小睡中受益。
exercises.upgrade: Older adults may benefit from short daytime naps.

options.explanation: 在一般健康語境中十分自然。

words.note: 可指下午躺下休息，有時包括睡著，有時只是閉目養神。
words.example: The children have a short afternoon rest after lunch.
words.exampleZh: 孩子們午飯後會有一段短暫的下午休息時間。

exercises.original: The children take afternoon naps after lunch.
exercises.zh: 孩子們午飯後會有一段下午休息時間。
exercises.upgrade: The children take afternoon rests after lunch.

options.explanation: 和 afternoon naps 很接近，但不一定真的睡著。

exercises.original: Residents are encouraged to have quiet afternoon naps if they feel tired.
exercises.zh: 住客如果感到疲倦，可在下午安靜休息。
exercises.upgrade: Residents are encouraged to have quiet afternoon rests if they feel tired.

options.explanation: 適合較柔和地描述午睡／休息。
太局限，也不一定休息或睡覺。

exercises.original: A short afternoon nap can be useful after a busy morning.
exercises.zh: 忙碌了一個早上後，短暫下午休息可能很有幫助。
exercises.upgrade: A short afternoon rest can be useful after a busy morning.

options.explanation: 很接近 nap，但語義稍廣。

words.meaning: 短暫的下午睡眠；下午小睡
words.note: 非常直接地把 afternoon naps 展開說明。
words.example: Short afternoon sleeps are common in some cultures.
words.exampleZh: 短暫的下午睡眠在某些文化中很常見。

exercises.original: Afternoon naps are common among young children.
exercises.zh: 短暫的下午睡眠在幼兒中很常見。
exercises.upgrade: Short afternoon sleeps are common among young children.

options.explanation: 幾乎直接展開 afternoon naps 的意思。

exercises.original: The doctor suggested brief afternoon naps rather than long daytime sleeping.
exercises.zh: 醫生建議短暫的下午睡眠，而不是長時間白天睡覺。
exercises.upgrade: The doctor suggested short afternoon sleeps rather than long daytime sleeping.

exercises.original: She says afternoon naps help her recover after an early start.
exercises.zh: 她說短暫下午睡眠能幫助她在早起後恢復精神。
exercises.upgrade: She says short afternoon sleeps help her recover after an early start.

words.note: 指中午前後的小睡，通常和下午較早時段的 nap 很接近。
words.example: A brief midday nap helped him stay focused during the afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 短暫的午睡令他下午更能集中精神。

exercises.original: He usually takes an afternoon nap shortly after lunch.
exercises.zh: 他通常在午飯後不久午睡。
exercises.upgrade: He usually takes a midday nap shortly after lunch.

options.explanation: 午飯後不久最符合 midday。

exercises.original: A brief afternoon nap helped her stay alert for the rest of the day.
exercises.zh: 短暫的午睡讓她在餘下時間保持精神。
exercises.upgrade: A brief midday nap helped her stay alert for the rest of the day.

options.explanation: 和下午較早時段的小睡非常接近。

exercises.original: The office introduced a quiet room for employees who want afternoon naps after lunch.
exercises.zh: 辦公室設置安靜房間，讓員工午飯後可以午睡。
exercises.upgrade: The office introduced a quiet room for employees who want midday naps after lunch.

options.explanation: after lunch 是非常明確的時間線索。

words.note: 指中午或下午早段的休息／小睡，特別與較炎熱地區或特定文化習慣相關。
words.example: Many shops close briefly while people take their afternoon siestas.
words.exampleZh: 很多商店會短暫關門，讓人們午睡休息。

exercises.original: In some regions, afternoon naps are a traditional part of daily life.
exercises.zh: 在某些地區，午睡是傳統日常生活的一部分。
exercises.upgrade: In some regions, siestas are a traditional part of daily life.

options.explanation: 具有文化習慣色彩的午睡最自然。

exercises.original: The town becomes very quiet during the traditional afternoon nap period.
exercises.zh: 在傳統午睡時段，這個小鎮變得非常安靜。
exercises.upgrade: The town becomes very quiet during the traditional siesta period.

options.explanation: 傳統午後休息時段很適合 siesta。

exercises.original: Some workers return home for an afternoon nap before going back to work.
exercises.zh: 有些工人會回家午睡，之後再返回工作。
exercises.upgrade: Some workers return home for a siesta before going back to work.

options.explanation: 符合午後暫停工作、小睡後再工作的習慣。

words.note: 較口語、輕鬆的說法，指短暫睡一會兒。
words.example: He enjoys a quick afternoon snooze on weekends.
words.exampleZh: 他週末喜歡在下午小睡一會兒。

exercises.original: He enjoys short afternoon naps on Sunday.
exercises.zh: 他星期日喜歡下午打個盹。
exercises.upgrade: He enjoys short afternoon snoozes on Sunday.

options.explanation: 口語、輕鬆地表示下午小睡。

exercises.original: A quick afternoon nap on the sofa made her feel better.
exercises.zh: 她在沙發上快速打了個下午盹，之後感覺好多了。
exercises.upgrade: A quick afternoon snooze on the sofa made her feel better.

options.explanation: quick 和 sofa 都很符合口語 snooze 語感。

exercises.original: She sometimes takes an afternoon nap while the baby is sleeping.
exercises.zh: 寶寶睡覺時，她有時也會在下午小睡一下。
exercises.upgrade: She sometimes takes an afternoon snooze while the baby is sleeping.

words.note: 指刻意安排的短暫小睡，目的是恢復精神和注意力。
words.example: She takes a twenty-minute power nap after lunch.
words.exampleZh: 她午飯後會小睡二十分鐘恢復精神。

exercises.original: She takes a short afternoon nap to regain energy before her evening shift.
exercises.zh: 她會在下午短暫補眠，為晚班恢復精神。
exercises.upgrade: She takes a power nap to regain energy before her evening shift.

options.explanation: 目的明確是快速恢復精神。

exercises.original: A twenty-minute afternoon nap helped him focus during the late meeting.
exercises.zh: 二十分鐘的下午補眠令他在較晚的會議中更集中。
exercises.upgrade: A twenty-minute power nap helped him focus during the late meeting.

options.explanation: 二十分鐘和提高專注力是典型 power nap 語境。

exercises.original: Many people use afternoon naps as a quick way to restore alertness.
exercises.zh: 很多人把下午小睡當作快速恢復精神的方法。
exercises.upgrade: Many people use power naps as a quick way to restore alertness.

options.explanation: 核心就是短暫睡眠後恢復警覺。

words.note: 非常短的小睡，通常比一般 nap 更短、更隨意。
words.example: He took a quick catnap in the afternoon before returning to work.
words.exampleZh: 他下午回去工作前快速打了個盹。

exercises.original: He took a very short afternoon nap before returning to work.
exercises.zh: 他回去工作前非常短暫地打了個下午盹。
exercises.upgrade: He took a quick catnap before returning to work.

options.explanation: 非常短的小睡最適合 catnap。

exercises.original: A five-minute afternoon nap was enough to make her feel refreshed.
exercises.zh: 五分鐘的下午小睡已足以令她恢復精神。
exercises.upgrade: A five-minute catnap was enough to make her feel refreshed.

options.explanation: 五分鐘特別符合 catnap 的超短小睡語感。

exercises.original: He often has tiny afternoon naps between appointments.
exercises.zh: 他常常在兩個約會之間短暫打盹。
exercises.upgrade: He often has quick catnaps between appointments.

options.explanation: 短、零碎、隨時打盹的感覺很自然。

falseSynonyms.zh: 睡眠不等於午睡 sleep 是一般睡眠概念，不表示短暫或下午。
falseSynonyms.point: He needs more sleep. He takes an afternoon nap.

falseSynonyms.zh: 休息時間不等於小睡 break 可以只是停止工作，不表示睡覺。
falseSynonyms.point: She took a break at three. She took a nap at three.

falseSynonyms.zh: 放鬆不等於睡眠 relaxation 可以包括閱讀、散步、聽音樂等。
就寢時間不等於午睡 bedtime 通常是晚上準備睡長覺的時間。
休息不一定等於睡著 rest 比 nap 更廣。 一個人可以休息但完全沒有睡。
